title: About Me
intro: Full stack developer and network infrastructure technician: I build web applications end to end and understand the network and servers they run on.
card1Text: I focus on deeply understanding the problem before writing code, designing simple, efficient, and modular solutions.
card2Text: I keep sharpening my skills with production-grade applications, design patterns and optimization, and I explore local AI with Ollama applied to automation.
card3Text: I work with agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban) and prioritize best practices, security and maintainable code to build dependable software.
p1: I’m especially interested in understanding how an application works beyond the interface: from endpoint design and business rules to code organization and database integration.
p2: I enjoy working on projects where I can apply good practices, write maintainable code, and improve both technically and in solving real problems.
p3: I complement my profile with advanced full stack projects: secure authentication, relational databases, Odoo integrations via XML-RPC/JSON-RPC and AI agents.
sideText1: Web development and internal platform support at Alasknet, and building full stack applications and AI-powered solutions.
sideText2: Backend architecture in ASP.NET Core and Node.js with reactive frontend in React.
